title: [Master]- [Planning Worksheet] Production Copy to Req. Wksh fails because destination fields are missing
summary: Fixed a bug where the Carry Out Action Message - Planning report failed to copy production orders to requisition worksheets due to missing destination fields being populated.
key_points: Report was unable to complete production order copy operations to requisition worksheets
Missing field mappings prevented data transfer between source and destination records
Added field population logic to the Carry Out Action Msg. - Plan. report
Test coverage added to verify the fix works correctly
Supply chain management planning operations now function as intended
